corpus_text:
The API gateway validates workspace scope before dispatching a query.

The retrieval service fuses BM25 and dense candidates with reciprocal-rank fusion.

The reranker selects evidence passages before synthesis.

Version two replaces the legacy lexical-only path with hybrid retrieval.

The migration guide requires rebuilding the dense index before enabling version two.

The deployment runbook enables version two only after the migration has completed.
